---
name: Bug Report
about: Report something that is broken or not working as expected.
title: '[BUG] '
labels: bug
---

### Describe the Bug

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.
_(e.g., "The link to the projects page in the footer is broken.")_

### To Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to page: '...'
2. Click on link/button: '....'
3. Observe the error: '....'
   _(Please be as specific as possible)_

### Expected Behavior

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
_(e.g., "I expected to be taken to the projects page.")_

### Screenshots

If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

### Optional: Environment Details

If you think it's relevant, please provide details about your environment:

- Device: [e.g., Desktop, iPhone 12, Android Tablet]
- OS: [e.g., Windows 10, macOS Sonoma, iOS 16]
- Browser: [e.g., Chrome, Safari, Firefox]
- Page URL: [e.g., /about, /contact]

### Additional Context

Add any other context about the problem here.
_(e.g., "This only happens when I'm logged out.")_
